title: A higher-frequency photon
hook: Change photon frequency and predict photon momentum magnitude.
misconception: photon momentum magnitude stays fixed when photon frequency doubles.
objective: Apply p = hf/c to compare photon momentum magnitude when photon frequency changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a photon in vacuum, p = hf/c. When photon frequency doubles, photon momentum magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model p = hf/c; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a photon in vacuum, with a nonzero initial result. If photon frequency triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on photon momentum magnitude?
recall.why: Apply p = hf/c under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
